# x30_modes figures (generated by ros2_ws/src/x30_modes/test/make_figures.py from results/modes/*.json)

* `m1_guard_fake_robot.png` (milestone: mux + guard + fake robot). Standstill gap between the robot edge and the obstacle after driving at the pillar/wall at
  0.2-0.6 m/s forward, 0.3 backward, 0.3 sideways, and when a box suddenly appears 1.0, 0.6 and 0.35 m ahead of the nose at 0.4 m/s. The dashed line is the configured
  stop margin (0.20 m). Zero collisions in all cases; gaps 0.18-0.24 m. The "past chair" case also grazes the chair at 0.13 m lateral clearance.
* `m2_primitive_accuracy.png` (milestone: primitives). Error of move_relative (cm) and turn_to (deg) against truth, fake robot (dots) and simulator (squares).
  Fake robot: max 2.2 cm and 2.2 deg; simulator: max 0.8 cm and 0.8 deg with the sim profile (coast_s 0.12).
* `m3_sim_wall_approach.png` (milestone: real simulator, `kinematic`, ROS_DOMAIN_ID 30). Time series of a 0.6 m/s command toward the east wall of default_arena:
  ground-truth x, the guard's output velocity and its clearance estimate. The guard slows from about 0.8 m clearance and holds the robot about 0.14 m from the wall
  (nominal margin 0.20 m; see docs/reports/modes.md, section on the simulator).
